name: Glasses & Amorphous Materials
summary: Explains the structure of non-crystalline solids, the glass transition and the processing and strengthening of oxide and metallic glasses.

topics.name: The glass transition: kinetics, fictive temperature and the Kauzmann paradox
Structure of silicate glasses: network formers, modifiers and intermediates
Describing amorphous structure: radial distribution functions
Viscosity-temperature behaviour: fragility and the VFT equation; working points
Commercial glasses: soda-lime, borosilicate, aluminosilicate, fused silica
Glass forming: float, drawn, blown and pressed glass; fibre drawing
Strengthening glass: thermal tempering and chemical ion exchange (Gorilla Glass)
Glass-ceramics: controlled nucleation and crystallisation (Zerodur, cooktops)
Chalcogenide and fluoride glasses for infrared optics
Metallic glasses and bulk metallic glasses
Amorphous semiconductors and oxide thin films
